question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Existence**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Existence **refers to the state or fact of having being or living. It denotes the presence or occurrence of something in the world. (अस्तित्व)

 
 
• **Example**: *The discovery of ancient fossils provides evidence of the existence of prehistoric animals that lived millions of years ago.*
 
 
 
• In this context, "**existence**" refers to the state of being, implying that the described punishment is applicable and present in any criminal legislation that is currently in force or operational worldwide.

Thus, **option 4** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Persistence: **Continued effort or determination in spite of challenges or obstacles. (अटलता)
 
• **Maintenance: **The act of preserving or keeping something in a particular state or condition. (रखरखाव)
 
• **Resistance: **The ability to withstand or oppose something, often applied to opposition against force, influence, or change. (प्रतिरोध)
